verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm the product's documentation hub is agent-oriented: an llms.txt index resolves at developers.openai.com/llms.txt and individual docs are also served as clean markdown (e.g., codex/skills.md), which is exactly the format AI-native agents consume. This is corroborated by first-party docs describing skills/plugins built around machine-readable manifests and MCP wiring. Missing for 10: no independent third-party report of an agent successfully ingesting these llms.txt files in practice, only first-party probes.
